notes.title: Zombie Watch Part II - Update 0.6
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43757180/be0e7b525640fee57e35e76cf19daabb65a9a307.png

Hello,

this update brings an exciting addition to Zombie Watch Part II as well as fixes several game-breaking bugs that were affecting the gameplay experience for some players. 

We added a new feature where players can now recruit and manage survivors to work for them, providing them with water, food, and medicine, or else they will perish. These survivors are your companions when exploring the game's vast open world and they will defend you and fight the zombies by your side. This feature adds a whole new layer of strategy and immersion to the game. They will be more useful as the development of the game goes further.

Additionally, the update has introduced new decorative items that players can use to customize their bases and make them more visually appealing.

Last but not least, we have continued to work on bugfixes to ensure that the game is running smoothly and without issue. Overall, these updates have made Zombie Watch an even more engaging and immersive survival game. 

Updates:
- survivors - hire more survivors if they die - food, water, medicine - they fight for you
 they will do more things when new functionalities are developed
- New decorative buildable's chair, table, fence 
- Added sensitivity slider
- Remapped change next/previous building
- Bugfixes

notes.title: Zombie Watch Part II - Release on 23th of March 2023
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43757180/37f3b564c3a9e58618f221e088131db856abc966.png

Hello survivors,

we are very excited to announce the release of Zombie Watch Part II in early access. It has been a great journey and we have all of you to thank for it. Your feedback and support on our first game Zombie Watch helped us tremendously. 

Zombie Watch Part II is a first-person survival game with a whole new set of challenges - you will find yourself in a world where zombies have taken over, and you must fight for your survival. With improved graphics, more challenging gameplay, and new features, this game promises to take your survival skills to the next level.

As you navigate through the zombie-infested world, you'll have to gather resources, scavenge for supplies, and craft weapons to defend yourself against the undead. Whether you're fighting off zombie hordes in abandoned buildings or navigating your way through dense forests, every step you take could mean the difference between life and death.

So what are you waiting for? Gather your wits, sharpen your survival skills, and join the fight for survival in Zombie Watch Part II.
